card.text: Jupiter's moon with the oldest, most heavily cratered surface known.

introduction.text: Callisto is almost as big as Mercury. Bright dots across it are likely crater peaks capped with water ice.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Detail ranges from 400 m to 60 km per pixel; shadows and seams in the photographs remain.

enhanced.title: Processed color mosaic
enhanced.summary: Galileo color from May 2001, covering about 29% of the globe. The colors are processed, not albedo.

infrared.title: Galileo NIMS spectral color
infrared.summary: False color from 0.77, 2.25 and 3.66 µm NIMS bands: spectral differences, not natural color.
